[.walkthrough]
.Put the first and last name side by side
. Select the components to wrap: click the first, then kbd:[Ctrl]-click the others (`⌘`-click on macOS).
+

. Open the menu, point at *Wrap with*, and choose a layout, here *Horizontal Layout*. The [.walkthrough-look]#new layout# takes their place in the form, with both fields in it.
